name: HeadNerf
definition: A generalized model to represent faces under different views, expressions, and illumination, conditioning the NeRF MLP on parameters controlling shape, expression, albedo, and illumination.
summary: HeadNeRF is a NeRF-based parametric head model that renders high-fidelity images in real-time by disentangling shape and appearance latent codes and using a 2D neural rendering module for acceleration.
